name: png-explain
description: One 16:9 infographic-style explainer PNG (2560x1440) comparing 2 or 3 concepts side by side: white page with a navy border, bold black title with one red accent word, header-pill panels with a definition, a TikZ/circuitikz or Python or downloaded figure, a boxed equation with symbol list, Key points and Example boxes with icons, and a full-width comparison table. Mostly black text, color only to highlight. Python SPEC -> LaTeX (tcolorbox, fontawesome5) with auto-fit to one page, plus .tex and .md copies. Skills: `png-explain`.
